extracted.intended_audience: Massachusetts-based artists, culture bearers, and creative practitioners interested in applying to the Mass Cultural Council Grants for Creative Individuals or learning grant-writing skills
extracted.subtask_description: A single free workshop (recorded video) teaching the application process, communication strategy, and materials organization for the Mass Cultural Council’s Grants for Creative Individuals; aimed at supporting historically marginalized artists and providing tech/one-on-one follow-up support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Grants for Creative Individuals
rubrics_metrics.description: These awards are unrestricted grants of $5,000 to Massachusetts artists, culture bearers, and creative practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants are intended to equitably advance state-wide creative expression throughout diverse communities. (Link provided to Mass Cultural Council grant page for more details.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshop topics / instructional scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Workshop will support participants in the ins and outs of the application process, communication strategy, and materials organizing for the MassCultural Council’s Grant for Creative Individuals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Workshop is taught by Wylder Ayres and aims to help with application materials and communication strategies; follow-up one-on-one sessions are available at Northampton Open Media.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attendance / materials requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Please bring a laptop to the workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you don’t have access to a computer, bring a phone or contact wylderayres@gmail.com for questions and support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical support availability
rubrics_metrics.description: A Digital Navigator (Hannah Cox) will be present to help answer tech questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After the workshop attendees can book one-on-one follow-up sessions at Northampton Open Media or drop in during open hours for additional support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant award characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grants for Creative Individuals are unrestricted $5,000 awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unrestricted funding implies recipients may use funds flexibly to advance their creative practice; the program emphasizes equitable advancement of creative expression across diverse communities.
